product_name: Post-Quantum Cryptography General Virtual Security Module (GVSM)
product_brief: Alibaba Cloud's beta Post-Quantum Cryptography GVSM, a cloud HSM integrating NIST PQC algorithms to protect data against quantum threats.
pqc_capability_description: Beta product integrating NIST PQC standardization project algorithms: FIPS-203 ML-KEM (CRYSTALS-Kyber), FIPS-204 ML-DSA (CRYSTALS-Dilithium), FIPS-205 SLH-DSA (SPHINCS+), LMS, and XMSS. Inherits existing HSM security features.
crypto_primitives: RSA, ECC, ML-KEM (CRYSTALS-Kyber), ML-DSA (CRYSTALS-Dilithium), SLH-DSA (SPHINCS+), LMS, XMSS
key_management_model: Cloud Hardware Security Module (HSM) service; customer-managed keys via GVSM; supports PKCS#11, JCE, CNG interfaces.
supported_blockchains: Not stated (mentions blockchain scenarios generally, but no specific networks)
architecture_type: Cloud Hardware Security Module (HSM) / Virtual Security Module (VSM)
fips_validated: No (References FIPS-203, FIPS-204, FIPS-205 standards, but does not state FIPS 140 validation status)
target_industries: Enterprise, IoT, Blockchain, Digital Assets, PKI, Government (implied by NIST compliance)
pqc_roadmap_details: Beta product currently available; advises stress testing before migration.
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Mentioned for IoT device security (identity authentication, firmware updates), but specific constraints/variants not detailed.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Requires stress testing before migration; gradual migration recommended to ensure stability.
